title: Lead Verification and Validation Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Lead Verification \& Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls \& Protection Verification and Validation team’s activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department. The role involves technical leadership on the various work packages within the department ensuring that they meet the requirements, and the relevant processes are followed.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Main duties and responsibilities will include.**
* 
+ Prepare and maintain Validation \& Verification team’s activity plans as per the Project scheduled.
+ Design and create FST and FAT test cases against design requirements.
+ Properly manage Validation team shift plan.
+ Leading the FAT with client.
+ Gap analysis between standard / design requirement and customer technical requirements further leading to defining of test requirement.
+ Understand the key milestones in the project plan, ensure that the plan correctly provisions for the required testing activities.
+ Clearly communicate details of failures to the respective engineering functions.
+ Knowledge of control system requirements for the RTDS LAB setup including AC DC interface requirement, Plant Emulator Interface requirement and RSCAD Power system network conversion, modelling and verification.
+ Problem solving skills to support test issues especially lab setup and debugging skills.
+ Strong sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage technical risks.
+ Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product care teams to develop existing and new products and tools.
+ Knowledge of Dynamic performance studies using both offline and online simulation tools (PSCAD/RSCAD).
+ Assist Validation Engineers to carry out execution of tests and provide clear reporting of results.
+ Review/analyze the test results thereby reporting the status.
+ Provide support to Commissioning Engineers during Dynamic commissioning at Site.
+ Support continual improvement, raising the effectiveness and efficiency of the team through the introduction of tools, methods and process improvements and coordinating with the Continuous Improvement leaders
+ Support a standard product methodology mindset, seek opportunities to re\-use solutions, improve quality and reliability whilst reducing the delivery timeline and associated costs.


**Qualifications / Essential Requirements**
* 
+ Engineering degree with 12\+ years of experience or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business.
+ Experience in the position of Verification Engineer in High Voltage field, preferably experience as a Control \& Protection design Engineer. Good knowledge of overall 400kV substation, HVDC system (LCC/VSC/SVC) including control and protection system is essential.
+ Knowledge and experience of developing and working with RSCAD models is preferred.
+ Knowledge of Overall HVDC System Operational behavior.
+ Strong communication skills with a fluency in English language.
+ Must be flexible with working hours and willing to travel to support projects globally.
+ Knowledge of applicable electrical standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 62351, IEC 12207, IEEE 15288, IEC 25010, IEC 27032, NERC/CIP will be an added advantage.
+ Experienced in technical leadership.


**Desired Requirements**
* 
+ Experience on MATCAD, PSCAD, PSS/E and MATLAB SIMULINK, EMTP\-RV, Dig silent etc. will add advantage.
+ Knowledge of Fault Recorder (TFR) systems.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: QA Engineer
description:
As a valued employee of the British Council, you already help us deliver our mission to support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For over 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
   

  

 You are part of our organisation in over 200 countries and territories and where we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.
   

  

**We connect. We inspire.**
**Job Title: QA Engineer**
* Pay Band – PB 6
* Closing Date – 10th October 2026
* Location – Noida
* Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract


**Purpose Of Job**
 Ensure high\-quality software delivery by actively contributing across the full development lifecycle, applying QA best practices, and promoting a strong focus on automated testing.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance the resilience, efficiency, and security of digital products while aligning with governance standards and user expectations
   

  

**Main opportunities/challenges for this role**
**Accountabilities, Responsibilities And Main Duties**
**QA Engineering \& Collaboration**
* Assist in maintaining quality standards for projects by providing support to team members.
* Engage with the QA community to learn about and adopt best practices.
* Support the implementation and adherence to quality standards and coding best practices.
* Support the culture of quality within the team and organisation by contributing to discussions and initiatives.
* Offer a quality assurance perspective in team discussions, focusing on the practical application of engineering stories.


**Product/Programme/Service Delivery**
* Where necessary, work with product leads to ensure quality in engineering stories.
* Support test team leads, product leads and stakeholders by executing tests to maintain quality in engineering stories.
* Follow established test standards and methods to ensure software development projects meet acceptance criteria at all stages.
* Execute automated and manual tests, ensuring products and services meet expected quality criteria.
* Assist in the maintenance of automated test scripts within the team’s frameworks.
* Perform manual testing activities to maximise test coverage and identify defects that might be missed by automated tests.
* Help to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines through collaborative efforts with engineering peers.
* Participate in TDD practices under the mentorship of more experienced team members.
* Use tools like JIRA for tracking defects and support effective communication regarding issues and their resolutions.
* Assist in the development of test plans and cases, focusing on clear and executable strategies for both manual and automated tests.
* Stay informed about current testing tools, methodologies, and industry best practices to support continuous improvement in quality processes.


**Risk \& Compliance**
* Support the identification of potential system risks and contribute to implementing security measures.
* Assist senior team members to ensure solutions meet industry standards, regulations, and data privacy requirements.
* Help to monitor and maintain tools for detecting and responding to any potential security or compliance issues.


**Analysis \& Reporting**
* Work alongside the team to gain an understanding of product requirements and user needs.
* Support the process of reporting on quality metrics and test results and contribute to data and insights to inform the QA engineering team, development team, product leads and stakeholders.


**Language Requirement**
 Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.
   

  

**Minimum/Essential**
**Role specific knowledge and experience**
* Experience in Quality Assurance, with experience of both manual and automated testing in agile environments.
* Understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and the role of QA.
* Experience of automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and exposure to scripting in Java, C\#, .NET, JavaScript, Typescript.
* An understanding of standard testing methodologies and events (e.g., Black\-box testing, story testing, regression testing).
* Knowledge of testing frameworks such as BDD tools and associated tools such as Cucumber.
* Basic knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Awareness of relational database concepts and SQL, and an ability to compose basic queries.
* An understanding of the concepts of CI/CD tools for test integration and automation.
* Experience in device and browser testing.
* Experience with raising defects in defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
* A practical grasp of fundamental web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, for the purposes debugging.
* Reliable written and oral communication skills to support the documentation of tests and reporting of defects.
* Manadate Experince selenium, playwright, API testing


**Desirable**
* Basic/beginner knowledge of cloud platforms for testing (e.g., AWS, Azure).
* Understanding of security testing concepts and practices.
* Exposure to performance testing concepts and tools.
* Critical thinking and an eye for detail in the QA process.
* Exposure to best practices in software security testing.
* Familiarity with usability and user experience (UX) testing..
* Awareness of Azure DevOps tools, especially Azure Test Plans through exposure or use
* Some exposure to automating web application tests using common tools or libraries in a test environment context
* Familiarity with basic application monitoring tools, such as Application Insights, and their importance in the QA/test proces.
* Basic knowledge or some experience with relational database testing, possibly with Azure SQL Database or similar.


 A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Experience Required** 
**:** 

 2 – 5 Years
 




**Position :** 
 Quality Assurance (QA) Executive
 



**Industry :** 
 Apparel / Garment Manufacturing \& Exports
 



**Category Coverage** 

 Activewear \& Casualwear
 




**Employment Type** 
 Full\-Time 
 



**Budget 30\-40k** 




  





**About Us** 




  





 At Musclemind, we're redefining active leisure — a category that bridges the gap between performance and lifestyle. Our brand is built on a mindset of strength, resilience, and transformation. We believe true power comes from within, and our designs are engineered to adapt to life's contrasts, from workout to weekend. As we grow our "Forged for Glory" campaign, we're looking for a talented QA Executive to help us uphold the quality and craftsmanship that our brand story is built on.
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented QA Executive with 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in the garment industry, covering both activewear and casualwear categories. The ideal candidate will bring a strong quality background from established brands and/or export houses, with solid exposure to men's and women's product lines across knitted and woven garments.
 



  





**Key Requirements** 




 • Experience with both activewear and casualwear categories.
 



 • Professional background with established brands and/or export houses.
 



 • Knowledge of men's and women's product categories.
 



 • Strong understanding of both knitted and woven garments.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 • Conduct in\-line, mid\-line, and final inspections to ensure garments meet buyer specifications and quality standards.
 



 • Review and verify fabric, trims, and accessories for compliance with approved standards before production.
 



 • Monitor construction, stitching, fit, and finishing across knitted and woven garment categories.
 



 • Identify, document, and follow up on quality defects; drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions with production teams.
 



 • Coordinate with merchandising, production, and buyer QA teams to ensure timely approvals and issue resolution.
 



 • Maintain quality inspection reports, AQL records, and audit documentation.
 



 • Ensure adherence to buyer\-specific quality manuals, testing protocols, and compliance requirements.
 



 • Support pre\-production meetings (PP meetings) to align on quality expectations before bulk production.
 



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




 • 2–5 years of relevant QA experience in the garment/apparel manufacturing or export industry.
 



 • Prior exposure to activewear and casualwear product lines is essential.
 



 • Experience working with recognized brands, buying houses, or export\-oriented manufacturing units.
 



 • Sound knowledge of garment construction techniques for both knitted and woven fabrics.
 



 • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and effective communication skills.
 



 • Ability to work cross\-functionally with production, merchandising, and buyer quality teams.
 



  





**Qualification** 
 • Diploma/Degree in Textile, Apparel Manufacturing, Fashion Technology, or a related field (preferred).

title: FS RC-FSRM - CSTC-MORTGAGE QUALITY CONTROL-QUALITY ASSURANCE-MANAGER
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)**
**Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst – Manager**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post\-underwriting and post\-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Perform pre\-funding and post\-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
* Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
* Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
* Validate collateral\-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
* Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e.g., Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
* Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
* Reconcile underwriting decisions by re\-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
* Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
* Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
* Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
* Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading


**Domain Skills Required**
* Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc.) and underwriting frameworks
* Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre\-funding and post\-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
* Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
* Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re\-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
* Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
* Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management\-ready findings


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* MBA/CA or equivalent with 7\-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
* Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage.
* Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage\-specific certifications
* Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
* Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to \- Head of Publishing Operations** 




  





**About Packt** 




 Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e\-books, audiobooks, and video courses.
 



 For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high\-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality\-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.
 



 The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.
 



 The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.
 



 This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Technical:** 



* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code\-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code\-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles



  





**Editorial:** 



* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet



**Author/Expert management:** 



* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators



  





**Who You Are** 




 You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high\-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.
 



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders



  





**Good\-to\-have skills:** 



* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality\-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast\-paced environments



  





**Why Work at Packt** 




 We are a global and remote\-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:
 


* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge\-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work\-life balance.



 We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:
 


* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer\-to\-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self\-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.



  





**Benefits:** 




 You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.
 



 Bonus scheme
 



 5 day working week
 



 25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)
 



 Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India
 



 Training programs and Certification
 



 Group Medical Insurance
 



 Wellness initiatives
 



  





**Salary Range \- INR 25 \- 60K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)** 




  





**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third\-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
QA Engineer to own quality validation across our Portal, Frontend, Analytics, and Grafana\-integrated features, and to serve as our primary Incident Coordinator. This is a hands\-on, ownership\-heavy role: you'll validate merged code before every release, sign off on features before they reach clients, coordinate incident response (including being the first point of contact during off\-hours L1/L2 incidents), and help build out our automated regression suite. This role replaces an existing team member and is expected to be fully operational within the first 60–90 days.
 


**Key Responsibilities** 

**QA Sign\-Off \& Release Validation** 




 • Validate merged code in both test and production environments before and after release, following the Code Review SOP.
 



 • Own post\-merge QA validation in the test environment and perform production smoke tests for every release PR.
 



 • Review and write QA test cases for new features (e.g., document management, form/data\-entry flows, dashboard integrations) before development is marked “Ready for QA.”
 



 • Track QA status and sign\-off in Jira; ensure no feature ships without a logged QA outcome.
 



**Incident Coordination \& On\-Call** 




 • Act as the primary Incident Coordinator: monitor the client support channel (email) and internal Slack incident channel, acknowledge incidents, and create Jira tickets with the correct severity (L1/L2/L3\), per the Incident Reporting SOP.
 



 • Serve as the Level 1 on\-call contact, with a target acknowledgment time of ≤ 1 hour, including best\-effort reachability during off\-hours (via phone/WhatsApp) for critical (L1\) and major (L2\) incidents.
 



 • Validate fixes before incident tickets are closed and confirm resolution with the reporting client or team member.
 



 • Escalate to Level 2/3 engineering contacts when incidents aren't acknowledged or resolved within SLA.
 



**Scheduled \& Preventive QA Checks** 




 • Perform monthly scheduled manual checks covering reporting accuracy, portal form validation, and data integrity, per the Scheduled Manual Checks SOP.
 



 • Log each check as a Jira task with findings and outcomes, and escalate critical findings through the Incident Reporting process.
 



 • Support quarterly security and process reviews (e.g., flagging QA\-relevant findings from dependency/security scans).
 



**Test Automation** 




 • Build and maintain an automated regression suite (QA Automation repo) using Playwright or Selenium for UI/E2E coverage, plus API\-level automation, to reduce reliance on manual regression testing over time.
 



 • Maintain and expand regression coverage in line with each release; document coverage changes in release notes.
 



  




**What You'll Work With** 

 • Web Portal: Django (backend), React (frontend)
 



 • Data \& Dashboards: Grafana, InfluxDB, MQTT\-based IoT data pipelines
 



 • Tooling: Jira, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), SonarQube (static analysis), Slack, Playwright/Selenium (test automation)
 



 • Process: Two\-week sprints, PR\-based code review with a single Tech Lead approver, staged branch promotion (dev/staging → main)
 



  




**Requirements** 

 • 2–4 years of hands\-on QA/software testing experience, ideally on a web application product (backend \+ frontend).
 



 • Strong manual testing skills: writing test cases, exploratory testing, regression testing, and production smoke testing.
 



 • Must have hands\-on automation testing experience with Playwright or Selenium — able to write and maintain automated test scripts, not just execute manual scripts.
 



 • Working knowledge of API testing (e.g., Postman, or automation frameworks such as pytest/requests) and appetite to build out automated coverage.
 



 • Comfortable reading data and validating dashboards/reports for correctness (experience with Grafana or similar BI/dashboarding tools is a plus).
 



 • Familiarity with Jira\-based workflows and bug lifecycle management.
 



 • Clear, calm communicator — this role is client\- and team\-facing during incidents and requires writing precise bug reports and status updates.
 



 • Willingness to be reachable during off\-hours for critical incident response, per the on\-call rotation.
 



 • Prior experience in SaaS, IoT, industrial monitoring, or similarly data\-heavy domains is a plus but not required.
 



  




**Nice to Have** 

 • Exposure to SQL and basic data validation queries.
 



 • Experience with AWS\-hosted applications (EC2, RDS, S3\) from a QA/operations perspective.
 



 • Prior experience as an incident coordinator or on\-call responder.

 Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R\&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.
   

  

 As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.
   

  

 In this context, you will be responsible for
 **Camera Image Sensor SoC validation** 
 , focusing on
 **Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System\-Level Functional validation** 
 .
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including
 **Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti\-Tamper mechanisms** 
 . The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python.
   

  

 Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.
   

  

 To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.
   

  

 You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.
   

  

 Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Validate end\-to\-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs.
* Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms:
+ Secure Boot
+ Chain of Trust
+ Secure Firmware Loading
+ Secure Debug Access
+ Secure Key Provisioning
+ Anti\-Tamper Mechanisms
+ Secure Manufacturing Flows
+ Secure video streaming

* Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Validate OTP \-based security configurations.

* Knowledge:
* Embedded electronics / computing (real time)

* Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP

 **Manager \- Electronics, Radio \& Radar Production and Assembly**

 **AS9100D** 
 and
 **ISO 9001:2015** 
 quality\-management systems.

* Lead production and assembly of electronic, radio, RF, microwave and radar systems, modules and subassemblies.

 **AS9100D** 
 ,
 **ISO 9001:2015** 
 , customer\-specific requirements and applicable defence quality standards.

* Support qualification and environmental testing, as applicable, including temperature, vibration, shock, humidity, ingress protection, burn\-in, EMI/EMC and reliability testing.
* Coordinate with approved laboratories and certification agencies for product testing, qualification and compliance activities.
* Review test procedures, acceptance test procedures, qualification test procedures and test reports.
* Manage calibration status and suitability of production and test equipment.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for production defects, test failures, field complaints and audit findings.
* Manage non\-conforming products through review, segregation, rework, repair and disposition processes.
* Support engineering\-change implementation and maintain configuration control across production.
* Improve first\-pass yield, productivity, throughput, on\-time delivery and overall equipment effectiveness while reducing rework, scrap and production costs.
* Develop operator skills through competency matrices, technical training and certification of special\-process personnel.
* Conduct production, quality, safety and delivery reviews, and submit accurate management reports.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, safety, accountability, confidentiality and continuous improvement.



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree or diploma in
 **Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electrical and Electronics, Instrumentation** 
 , or a related engineering discipline.
* **10\-15 years of relevant experience** 
 , including significant responsibility for electronics production, assembly, integration and testing.
* Experience in the
 **defence, aerospace, radar, radio, communication or mission\-critical electronics industry is a must** 
 .
* Practical knowledge of
 **AS9100D** 
 and
 **ISO 9001:2015** 
 quality\-management requirements.
* Experience with defence quality assurance, customer inspections, product testing, qualification and certification.
* Strong understanding of electronic manufacturing processes, PCB assemblies, wiring harnesses, RF assemblies, system integration and electromechanical production.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, bills of materials, specifications, test requirements and work instructions.
* Experience with production planning, manpower management, process control, configuration management and supply\-chain coordination.
* Knowledge of quality tools such as 8D, 5\-Why, fishbone analysis, CAPA, FMEA, control plans and statistical process control.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, production dashboards and manufacturing performance indicators.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.



  





**Preferred Knowledge** 



* Radio\-frequency and microwave assembly practices, shielding, grounding, impedance\-sensitive interconnections and RF testing.
* Radar subsystems, transmit\-receive modules, antenna assemblies, power supplies, signal\-processing units and communication equipment.
* IPC workmanship standards for electronic and cable assemblies.
* EMI/EMC compliance, environmental qualification and reliability testing for defence electronics.
* Defence inspection and acceptance processes involving customer\-nominated quality agencies.
* Supplier qualification, special\-process validation, obsolescence management and counterfeit\-part prevention.
* Lean manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S and structured cost\-reduction initiatives.



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Production plan and delivery achievement
* First\-pass yield and right\-first\-time performance
* Rejection, rework and scrap rates
* Customer inspection and acceptance success
* Qualification and certification milestone completion
* Product and process non\-conformance closure
* Corrective\-action effectiveness
* Productivity and capacity utilisation
* Production cost and material\-yield performance
* Audit compliance and documentation accuracy
* Safety and 5S performance
* Workforce competency and training completion



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on production leader who combines
 **electronics manufacturing expertise, defence\-quality discipline and team leadership** 
 . The person should be comfortable working with multidisciplinary engineering teams, customers, quality representatives, laboratories, suppliers and certification agencies while delivering reliable products under demanding technical and schedule requirements.
 








**Application** 




 Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn with an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in electronics, radio or radar production, defence quality assurance, product testing, qualification and certification.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
**Eykon Private Limited** 
 , formerly part of the Landis\+Gyr Group, supports electricity, gas, water and thermal utilities in managing increasingly complex networks, improving operational efficiency and enabling more sustainable use of resources.

 **2\.800 employees in 19 countries** 
 and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a standalone organisation, Landis\+Gyr EMEA builds on long\-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Purpose and Objective
   

  

 To ensure firmware and software products are developed and released with the highest levels of quality, reliability, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

* Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, project, manufacturing, and supplier teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate quality and project risks before they impact customers or schedules.
* Ensure compliance with customer, industry, regulatory, and company quality standards.
* Drive defect prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development processes, product quality, and team effectiveness.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide independent quality oversight at key project milestones.
* Ensure products meet customer expectations and are fit for purpose before release.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Firmware/Software PQE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Escaped Defect Rate: Percentage of defects discovered after release, measuring effectiveness of defect prevention and verification activities.
* Defect Detection Efficiency (DDE): Percentage of defects identified before release versus total defects found.
* Quality Gate Compliance: Percentage of projects passing phase/gate reviews on schedule with no major quality findings.
* Requirements Traceability Coverage: Percentage of requirements traced through design, testing, and validation to release.
* High\-Risk Closure Rate: Percentage of critical risks mitigated or closed before project milestones and release.
* Customer\-Reported Defects: Number of software/firmware defects reported by customer’s post\-release.
* CAPA Effectiveness: Percentage of corrective and preventive actions successfully implemented without recurrence.
* Continuous Improvement Delivery: Number and impact of implemented quality improvements resulting in reduced defects, improved compliance, or increased development efficiency.


**Overview Of The Role**
 The Firmware/Software Project Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software and firmware products are developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with customer, regulatory, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
   

  

 The role provides independent quality governance throughout the development lifecycle, driving risk mitigation, defect prevention, process compliance, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Core Areas of Responsibility/Accountability**
* Lead quality planning and governance throughout the firmware/software development lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Drive risk management, including FMEA, CTQ identification, and mitigation activities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to embed quality, reliability, and compliance into product development.
* Review and approve key quality deliverables, design documentation, and validation plans.
* Facilitate quality reviews, design reviews, and release readiness assessments.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and defect prevention activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide project quality reporting and oversight.
* Support audits, supplier quality activities, NPI, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the independent quality representative, ensuring products meet requirements and are delivered right first time.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women.
 



 Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women).
 



 We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent.
 



 AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper.
 



 That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 A Forward\-Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works where the product meets the client.
 



 You are the partner's point of contact and the person who makes our AI work in their world.
 



 At Uplevyl, our partners are mission\-driven organizations deploying UpGenie into domains where accuracy carries real consequences. Someone acting on one of our answers may be making a decision about their safety, their job, or their rights.
 



 The FDE owns that last mile: you sit in partner calls, understand what they actually need, configure and validate the system for their domain, and carry their feedback back into the product as clear engineering priorities.
 



 This role is equal parts technical depth and client trust. You will read the system well enough to debug it, and read the room well enough to run it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Partner Relationship, End to End** 



* Be the named point of contact for a partner deployment.
* Run the delivery loop: UAT cycles, release notes, working sessions, and honest conversations when something needs more time.



**Deployment \& Configuration** 



* Stand up UpGenie for a partner's domain: their data, jurisdictions, and workflows.
* Own the gap between a working product and a working deployment.



**Answer Quality the Partner Can Trust** 



* Design and run testing that proves the system is right.
* Build structured test frameworks, error categorization, root\-cause analysis, and validation loops over underlying sources.
* When quality slips, identify why and drive the fix.



**Translation in Both Directions** 



* Turn a partner's ask into a specification and estimate that engineering can build against.
* Turn technical decisions into language a partner understands and agrees with.



**Delivery Workflows, Automated by You** 



* Build AI tooling that removes manual work from delivery.
* Create validation pipelines, testing harnesses, and reporting systems.
* Build these yourself rather than waiting on the core team.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We hire across levels. A track record of building, shipping, and holding client trust matters more than years of experience, though real client\-facing engineering experience helps.
 


* **High Agency** 
 – You unblock yourself. When a deployment stalls or a partner escalates, you work out the next move and make it.
* **Technical Range** 
 – You can read a production AI system end to end: query the data, trace a wrong answer to its cause, script your own tooling, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You use AI daily to build.
* **Client Presence** 
 – You are calm and credible in the room, including when something has gone wrong. Partners trust you because you are straight with them and you deliver.
* **Rigor Under Pressure** 
 – You test before you claim. In our domains, a wrong answer reaching a user is a serious failure, and you treat it that way.
* **Sharp Writing** 
 – Your release notes, status updates, and client emails are clear, honest, and tight.
* **A Builder Who Ships** 
 – You have things live that prove it: tools, integrations, internal systems. You follow the frontier and form your own view on what is useful versus hype.
* **Judgment** 
 – You know what to surface to a partner, what to resolve quietly, and when to pull in leadership.



  





**Even Better If** 



* You have worked as a Solutions Engineer, Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or Technical Consultant.
* You have deployed or operated LLM or RAG systems in production.
* You have worked with legal, regulated, or otherwise high\-stakes data.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before You Apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is.
 



 This is a high\-bar role on a small, senior team. The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards—in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn—match them.
 



 If you want a defined lane and a slow ramp, this is not the right fit, and that is fine.
 



 If you want to be the person a partner calls first, and the engineer who makes an AI system trustworthy where it matters most, we want to hear from you.
 



 Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 



  





**How We Work at Uplevyl** 



* **We Finish What We Start** 
 – We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We Listen Before We Decide** 
 – Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way—by consistently showing up for people.
* **We Move With Ownership \& Urgency** 
 – We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* **We Are Better Together Than Alone** 
 – We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create.
* **We Stay Curious \& Keep Learning** 
 – We keep learning, including how to use AI well. We hold ourselves to the bar we're building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

title: Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialist - Video RL
description:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialists to support a Video Reinforcement Learning (Video RL) program focused on AI\-generated videos, autonomous agents, physical\-AI simulations, and spatial reasoning. The role involves reviewing AI\-generated video outputs and evaluating whether the AI is performing actions correctly, logically, and realistically.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Review AI\-generated videos frame\-by\-frame and evaluate the correctness of actions and movements.
* Check temporal sequence, action order, and cause\-effect relationships in videos.
* Evaluate whether AI\-generated actions are aligned with the intended goal or task.
* Identify spatial, physical, visual, and motion\-related errors in AI outputs.
* Review video segmentation, bounding boxes, masks, object boundaries, and avatar/character movements.
* Identify issues such as visual hallucinations, unnatural physics, clipping, incorrect movements, and inconsistencies.
* Provide clear, structured and evidence\-based feedback explaining why an AI output is correct or incorrect.
* Support the creation and validation of ground\-truth datasets and edge\-case scenarios.



  





**Mandatory Requirements:** 




 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in STEM \- Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Data Science or related field.
 



  





**Relevant exposure to at least one of the following:** 



* Video Analysis
* Computer Vision
* AI/ML
* Reinforcement Learning
* Robotics / Simulation
* Video/Data Annotation
* AI Model Evaluation
* Strong spatial and temporal reasoning skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when analyzing visual content frame\-by frame.
* Ability to identify logical, physical and visual inconsistencies in videos.

**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  





 We are looking for a highly skilled
 **QC Engineer \- MEP \& BMS** 
 with 6\-7 years of experience in quality control and assurance of Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP), and Building Management Systems (BMS) projects. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all MEP and BMS installations, testing, commissioning, and documentation activities comply with project specifications, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations.
   

  





 The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of MEP systems, BMS controls, QA/QC procedures, inspections, testing protocols, and project documentation.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Quality Control \& Inspection
   

  




* Implement and maintain project\-specific QA/QC plans, procedures, and inspection protocols.
* Conduct inspections of MEP and BMS installations to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Verify material deliveries, equipment installations, and workmanship quality at site.
* Prepare and manage Inspection Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Checklists.
* Monitor installation activities and proactively identify quality issues and non\-conformities.



 MEP System Quality Assurance
   

  




* Ensure quality compliance for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, ELV, and associated MEP systems.
* Verify installation of equipment such as chillers, AHUs, FCUs, pumps, transformers, switchgear, generators, and fire alarm systems.
* Review shop drawings, technical submittals, and material approvals from a quality perspective.
* Coordinate with consultants and project teams to resolve quality\-related observations.



 BMS Quality \& Testing
   

  




* Review and verify BMS installations, control panels, sensors, actuators, controllers, and field devices.
* Ensure correct integration of HVAC, Fire Alarm, Lighting Control, Energy Management, and other building automation systems.
* Monitor testing, functional checks, point\-to\-point verification, and commissioning activities.
* Validate BMS control logic and system performance against project requirements.



 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  




* Maintain QA/QC records, inspection reports, NCRs (Non\-Conformance Reports), and corrective action reports.
* Prepare quality documentation required for project audits and client submissions.
* Ensure all testing and commissioning reports are complete and properly documented.
* Support project handover by compiling quality dossiers and as\-built documentation.



 Testing \& Commissioning Support
   

  




* Witness testing and commissioning activities for MEP and BMS systems.
* Coordinate with commissioning teams, consultants, and contractors during system validation.
* Verify performance test results and ensure closure of punch\-list items.
* Ensure successful system handover and client acceptance.



 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  




* Work closely with project managers, site engineers, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Conduct quality awareness sessions and toolbox talks when required.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide quality status updates.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\-7 years of experience in QA/QC for MEP and BMS projects.
* Strong understanding of building services, automation systems, testing, and commissioning processes.
* Experience working on commercial buildings, data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial projects, or large infrastructure projects.

title: Functional Validation
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**YOUR ROLE**
 Lab validation and characterization
   

  

 Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R\&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.
   

  

 As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.
   

  

 In this context, you will be responsible for developing the validation environment (definition of the tests suite, of the test bench in the laboratory, of the hardware, development of stimuli, automation, documentation). To do this, you will benefit from the different areas of technical expertise of our employees in testing, optics, electronics, mechanics, and software development.
   

  

 Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.
   

  

 To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.
   

  

 You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.
   

  

 Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Experiences**
* Object\-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
* Version management tools (git, svn)
* Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
* Knowledge:
* Embedded electronics / computing (real time)


 Exp: 7 to 12yrs
   

  

* Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc.)
* Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI
* Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
* Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.


 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.

We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

* Full\-stack QA in cloud environments (AWS); .NET/C\#, React, Angular, MySQL, SQL Server, LAMP stack

* Strong mentoring and coaching skills with junior engineers
  
* Adaptability, leveraging technology, attention to detail, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, problem solving/analytical mindset
  
* Preferred: Familiarity with supply chain software. Experience with queues, caches, CDNs, and testing scalable web applications.
  


  


**Key Performance Indicators** 



  


 Test coverage · Mentorship impact · Defect leakage rate · Quality improvements

title: Software Tester (QA Engineer)
description:

 Software Tester (QA Engineer) – 4 to 7 years Experience
 



**Position:** 
 Software Tester (QA Engineer)
 



**Experience** 
 : 4 to 7 years 
 



**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, Work from Office 
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive Software Tester (QA Engineer) with 4\+ years of experience in manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, hands\-on experience in software testing methodologies, and the ability to ensure the delivery of high\-quality software products by identifying defects and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Analyze business and functional requirements to create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
2. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, and sanity testing.
3. Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using industry\-standard automation tools.
4. Identify, document, track, and verify software defects using bug\-tracking tools.
5. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to resolve issues efficiently.
6. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and sprint reviews.
7. Execute API testing using tools such as Postman or Swagger.
8. Perform database validation using SQL queries.
9. Ensure software quality through continuous testing during the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
10. Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, and quality metrics.
11. Contribute to process improvements and QA best practices.



  





**Required Skills** 



1. 4\+ years of experience in Software Testing/Quality Assurance.
2. Strong knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
3. Experience in Manual Testing and Automation Testing.
4. Hands\-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, or Playwright.
5. Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or TestRail.
6. Hands\-on understanding of API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
7. Good knowledge of SQL for database validation.
8. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
9. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
10. Strong verbal and written communication skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



1. Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter is an advantage.
2. ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is preferred.
3. Experience testing web, mobile, or cloud\-based applications is a plus.



  





**Education** 




 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

* Proficient with Linux and Windows environments.
* System Administration experience (small system or personal networks is great).

* Innate desires to automate, monitor and continually improve everything in sight.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.
   

  

 Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.
   

  

 You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high\-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.
 



 The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer\-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.

 As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high\-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

 This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

**Job Description Summary**
 For Grid Solutions, Offshore HVDC represents a key differentiating technology and a central focus for the business, particularly in Europe where Transmission System Operators have very ambitious renewable energy targets. In that context and for Germany, Grid Solutions is partnering with German TSOs which plans to invest more than $30B by 2030 in deploying new HVDC converter stations to bring Offshore Wind energy into Germany and the Netherlands.
   

  

 In this context, Grid Solutions is looking for a Lead Systems Engineer responsible for planning, supervising, and coordinating all systems engineering technical tasks required to realize the above project objectives, whether those tasks are undertaken in house or by Suppliers/Sub\-Contractors.

**Job Description**
**Essential Responsibilities**
**Engineering Management**
* Perform in\-depth Requirements Analysis system requirements to support project needs.
* Gather stakeholder technical needs and translate them into clear, verifiable system requirements.
* Allocate system requirements across subsystems, and relevant requirement owners.
* Develop and manage Verification \& Validation Plans and Reports for system requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to coordinate Verification \& Validation activities through all project phases.
* Ensure the quality and consistency of systems engineering deliverables.
* Manage and ensure effective communication of all relevant data within and across the requirements management database.
* Supervise and manage systems engineering tasks to achieve project objectives.

Maintain a library of these requirements by project type, such that they can easily be added to new projects and tenders at their commencement.


**Quality**
* Advocate for the adoption of best practices in Systems Engineering to improve the delivery of the Engineering function.

**Qualifications / Requirements**

* Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Have a strong understanding of dependability management and relevant industry standards.
* Be able to adapt to changing requirements and priorities.

Demonstrated ability to manage programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Fluent in English; additional language (any foreign Language) is a plus.
* Proven technical leadership in a complex system engineering development environment.

* Strong leadership, supportive and team coordination abilities to guide and mentor junior RMS engineers

title: Field Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
* Execute SQL queries to extract, clean, and analyze field performance metrics, repair data, and telemetry logs; identify and flag data anomalies for quality assessment.
* Perform end\-to\-end Failure Analysis (FA) on physical hardware samples, including board\-level debug and component diagnostics, and document findings in issue\-tracking databases.
* Conduct on\-site technical audits at repair centers and manufacturing partners, including inventory checks, root\-cause data collection, and physical hardware verification to validate repair procedures.
* Prepare detailed technical reports based on failure\-analysis investigations and data analysis, providing clear diagnostic evidence to support engineering decisions.
* Monitor bug trackers and quality databases to follow investigation progress, identify technical bottlenecks, and escalate issues based on data trends.
* Prepare regular standardized field\-quality reports using established templates and communicate key findings to relevant cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Key Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
* 0 \- 4 years of relevant experience in field quality, hardware failure analysis, repair engineering, manufacturing quality, or related technical areas.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and analysis.
* Familiarity with board\-level diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and failure\-analysis software.
* Practical experience applying 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or similar root\-cause identification methods in a hardware environment.
* Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues and derive data\-backed insights with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to service centers and manufacturing sites to conduct independent diagnostic and audit work.
* Good written and spoken English.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in high\-volume consumer electronics manufacturing, connected\-device repair, service operations, or factory production environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to repair\-center audits, manufacturing\-site audits, or field\-quality investigations.
* Experience working with technical issue\-tracking systems, quality databases, or standardized reporting tools.
* Professional fluency in spoken and written Hindi and English to support local vendor communication, site activities, and regional cross\-functional collaboration.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
