 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our scrum team as a hands\-on quality champion. This is an individual\-contributor role, but you'll be expected to lead by influence — raising the bar for how the whole team thinks about testing and quality. You'll be embedded from day one of refinement through release, testing across the stack, and coaching engineers to build quality in rather than bolt it on afterward.
   

  

**Day in the life:**
* Design and execute tests across API, integration, end\-to\-end, and admin interface layers
* Test decoupled and headless architectures, including API contract testing between backend services and consuming frontends
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, bringing a testing and quality lens to story definition and acceptance criteria
* Coach and mentor engineers on quality practices — testable design, effective test strategy, and shared ownership of quality
* Build, maintain, and evolve testing tooling and integrations within CI pipelines
* Partner closely with developers, product managers, and other quality engineers to identify risk areas and prioritize test coverage
* Continuously improve test suites for reliability, speed, and maintainability


**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**
* 7\+ years of experience in quality/test engineering (10\+ years preferred)
* Strong experience testing APIs, integrations, end\-to\-end flows, and admin/back\-office interfaces
* Proven experience testing decoupled or headless architectures, with hands\-on API contract testing between services and frontends
* Comfort working in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Practical experience with:
* E2E/UI testing: Playwright or Cypress
* Unit/integration testing: Jest
* Contract testing: Pactum
* API tooling: Postman or Bruno
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions
* Experience embedding quality practices into agile/scrum ceremonies, particularly refinement
* Strong communication skills and comfort coaching other engineers without formal authority


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with performance and load testing


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Quality Engineer Technical Lead, you will be expected to lead the quality engineering strategy for the team with strong ownership of automation, performance validation, test reliability, and production\-quality observability. You will drive and maintain the Automation Suite framework used across the team, define scalable automation practices, strengthen regression and integration coverage, and ensure that quality gates are embedded effectively across delivery pipelines. The role requires strong hands\-on exposure to performance testing, troubleshooting distributed applications in Kubernetes environments, and using observability tools such as Datadog and logging frameworks to diagnose issues, improve system reliability, and support faster root\-cause analysis. Along with individual contribution, you will mentor engineers, guide test design, improve engineering productivity, support customer escalations, and continuously enhance the overall quality posture of the product.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Quality Engineer Technical Lead will be responsible for leading the quality engineering charter for the team, including automation strategy, test framework ownership, performance validation, release quality, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
* Own, maintain, and evolve the Automation Suite framework used by the whole team, ensuring that it is scalable, reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to extend across functional, regression, integration, and API test scenarios.
* Define automation best practices, coding standards, reusable utilities, test data strategies, reporting mechanisms, and execution patterns that improve team productivity and reduce manual validation effort.
* Build and strengthen a robust suite of performance tests covering key product workflows, scalability scenarios, load profiles, reliability checks, and performance regression detection.
* Work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to embed quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and ensure that automation, regression, and performance feedback is available early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide strong troubleshooting support for issues observed in Kubernetes\-based deployments, including pod failures, service connectivity, resource constraints, configuration issues, and environment\-related problems.
* Use observability platforms such as Datadog, application logs, metrics, dashboards, traces, and logging frameworks to perform root\-cause analysis and support faster resolution of production and pre\-production issues.
* Mentor quality engineers and developers on automation design, testability, performance analysis, defect investigation, and engineering practices that improve overall product quality.
* Support customer escalations by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and telemetry, validating fixes, and ensuring relevant automated coverage is added to prevent recurrence.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation reliability, execution speed, test coverage, performance benchmarking, observability, and quality engineering processes.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 7\+ years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, performance testing, and technical leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing, developing, maintaining, and scaling automation frameworks for API, UI, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end test coverage.
* Proven ability to lead an Automation Suite framework for a team or program, including framework architecture, reusable components, test orchestration, reporting, maintainability, and adoption by multiple engineers.
* Good programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language used for automation development, test utilities, scripting, and framework enhancements.
* Strong experience with performance testing tools and practices, including load testing, scalability testing, baseline creation, bottleneck identification, trend analysis, and performance regression validation.
* Good troubleshooting exposure in Kubernetes\-based environments, including deployments, pods, services, ingress, configuration, resource utilization, logs, and common runtime issues.
* Hands\-on exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, with the ability to analyze dashboards, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health indicators.
* Strong understanding of logging frameworks and log analysis practices to support debugging, defect triaging, root\-cause analysis, and production issue investigation.
* Experience integrating automation suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensuring automated quality gates are reliable, actionable, and aligned with release expectations.
* Exposure to cloud\-native applications, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed system behavior will be an important factor.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect automation failures, performance trends, logs, metrics, and deployment behavior to identify issues quickly and accurately.
* Ability to mentor team members, review automation code, improve test design, promote quality ownership, and collaborate effectively with engineering, DevOps, and product stakeholders.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 0–3 Years** 




 Compensation:
 **₹3–5 LPA** 




  




**About Typesider** 

 Typesider is a reward based Windows desktop application that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.
 



 Users earn Typoints based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and soon, cashback.
 



 Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a privacy first approach. It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.
 



 We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.
   




**About the Role** 

 We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.
 



 You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.
 



 This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.
   




**What You’ll Do** 

 • Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
 



 • Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
 



 • Test new features and product updates before release
 



 • Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
 



 • Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
 



 • Verify fixes and perform regression testing
 



 • Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
 



 • Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
 



 • Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
 



 • Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 • 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
 



 • Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
 



 • Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
 



 • Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
 



 • Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
 



 • Good analytical and problem solving skills
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills
 



 • Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
 



 • Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work
   




**Good to Have** 

 • Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 



 • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
 



 • Basic understanding of API testing
 



 • Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
 



 • Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts
   




**What We Value** 

 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.
 



 A good QA engineer should be able to ask:
 



 What happens if the user does this?
 



 What happens if the system fails here?
 



 Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?
 



 Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?
 



 Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.
   




**Why Join Typesider** 

 Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.
 



 You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.
   




**Work Details** 

 Experience: 0–3 Years
 



 Compensation: ₹3–5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Work Mode: Hybrid
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 



 Working Hours: 10AM \- 6PM

 WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands\-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 The team delivers data management, software development, and web\-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices.

 Test Planning, Automation \& Execution
   

  

* Lead risk\-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases.

 Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
